description: This file defines the cSettings class, which manages configuration settings stored in a JSON-like structure, including file I/O operations for reading and writing configuration data.

classes.name: cSettings
classes.description: A class for managing configuration settings stored in a JSON object, with methods for getting, setting, removing values, and persisting to a file.

methods.name: cSettings
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the settings object, creating the file if it does not exist.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a given key from the JSON data.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Overloaded methods to set a key-value pair with string, int, or bool values, then write to file.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a key exists and is non-empty in the JSON data.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key-value pair from the JSON data.

methods.name: writeToFile
methods.description: Serializes the JSON data to the configuration file.

methods.name: readFromFile
methods.description: Initializes the JSON object from the configuration file.
